text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling after steep declines and buying back at higher prices has hurt my results; I should use clear, consistent rules rather than react to short-term moves.","A losing position deserves a fresh assessment of its outlook and role in my portfolio—not an automatic sale, nor an automatic commitment to buy more.","With my goal of beating the market, I should review overall performance, diversification, and cash discipline over the long run instead of judging each trade by its entry price alone."]}
